title: Full NativeAOT Compatibility with Zero Reflection on Hot Path
body: All ViceSharp assemblies shall be fully compatible with .NET NativeAOT publication. This means no use of runtime reflection, `System.Reflection.Emit`, or dynamic code generation on the emulation hot path. All assemblies shall pass the NativeAOT trim analysis without warnings. Source generators shall be used where compile-time code generation is needed.
